subject: Hands-on sprint: routing & load validation + visitor access / recording policy
messages:
From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>

Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 7 Nov 2027 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Hands-on sprint: routing & load validation + visitor access / recording policy

Hi Lydia —

Following our call last week, we'd like to schedule a hands-on sprint to do three things: prompt review and routing checks, short load validation (targeting our steady-state routing paths), and get everyone comfortable with screen-sharing/recording workflows. High-level notes: 

- Proposed scope: prompt tuning walk-through (30m), routing & failover tests (45m), 15–20 minute tokenized load validation window (burst then steady), wrap-up and action items.
- Time options: Nov 16–19 between 09:00–13:00 PT (we can split into two half-days if you prefer).
- Format: hybrid. Redwood will host on-site in our SF office (visitor badges required) and provide a Zoom room for remote participants.
- AV & recording: We typically record sessions for internal notes but will only record with explicit attendee consent. We need LedgerWorks to confirm recording permission for any contractors.
- Access: For on-site visits, please provide full names and company IDs for badge pre-approval. Office entry requires ID and sponsor.

Attachment: Agenda_v1.pdf (light agenda with timings and breakouts).

Can you confirm: preferred date(s), whether contractors (DevOps) will attend in person, and any recording/data retention constraints? Also flag any constraints for your security or procurement teams.

Thanks — looking forward to getting this into calendar.

Best,
Soojin Lee
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
soojin_lee@redwood.com
(415) 555-0198
